prompt:
Image 1 is the finished sheet; image 2 is its layout: 2 building outlines seen from above on flat magenta, in a 2×1 grid. Redraw only cell 1 (the transparent area). Keep cell 2 exactly as it is, and match its style, colours and fine detail.

The faults in cell 1: the light well showed its inner walls with rows of windows and its floor, and each dormer was drawn as a little house with a wall and a window, all seen from the side. Looking straight down no wall is seen: the light well is a dark rectangular opening about 4 × 10 m showing only its rim, and a dormer is a small roof shape about 1.5 m wide (about 33 px here) with no wall or window showing. A chimney stack is about 0.6 m, about 13 px here.

For the redrawn cell, trace the outline in image 2 exactly, keep its proportions, straight square edges, top-down with no perspective, and keep the magenta background flat pure #FF00FF outside it. Details at true size: this block stands next to cars 4 m long (about 87 px here). No text.

1. 20.8 × 43.6 m (2.1× deeper than wide) — deep old-town apartment block, hipped roof of dark bitumen round a light well, dormers and chimney stacks, standing narrow end to the street with the entrance on that short front wall
